rules.rule: every root has identity, purpose, owner/custodian and version
every root belongs to the one canonical sheikha-main-portal Git repository
irrigation inputs require source, quality state, rights/authority where applicable, and timestamp/version
growth is versioned and evidence-bound; no silent mutation
propagation is authorized derivation, never autonomous self-replication
planting requires parent root, destination, owner, scope and authority
a root cannot grant itself new authority
derived roots remain traceable to parent and version
landscape bindings reference existing modules and do not silently move them
religious, legal, physical and technical claims remain bounded by evidence
